name: The Great Journey

rules.name: Fanatical Doctrines
text: SAN'SHYUUM models from your army have the following ability.

**Voice of the Great Journey:** At the start of any phase, this model can issue one Fanatical Doctrine it has not issued this turn to one friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 6" that is not affected by a Fanatical Doctrine. Until the end of the phase, that unit is affected by that Doctrine. Each SAN'SHYUUM model can issue one Fanatical Doctrine per phase. A unit can be affected by one Caste Doctrine and one Fanatical Doctrine at the same time.

**Shielded by Faith:** Models in this unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
**Claim the Sacred Path:** Add 2 to the OC characteristic of models in this unit.
**Armour of the Faithful:** Improve the Sv characteristic of models in this unit by 1 (to a maximum of 2+).

rules.name: Devoted Sergeants
text: UNGGOY Sergeant models from your army have the following ability.
**Fanatical Preacher:** At the start of any phase, instead of issuing a Caste Doctrine this battle round, this model can issue one Fanatical Doctrine to its unit.

enhancements.name: Voice of Salvation
text: The bearer gains the Voice of the Great Journey ability. When it uses that ability, it can select an eligible unit within 9" instead of 6".

enhancements.name: Icon of the Sacred Path
text: Friendly COVENANT INFANTRY units within 6" of the bearer can re-roll battle-shock rolls. While such a unit is within range of an objective marker, the OC characteristic of models in that unit cannot be modified below 1.

enhancements.name: The Final Sermon
text: Once per battle, when the bearer is destroyed, before removing it from play, select up to three friendly COVENANT INFANTRY units within 9". For each selected unit, select one Fanatical Doctrine. Until the end of the phase, that unit is affected by that Doctrine. A unit already affected by a Fanatical Doctrine cannot be selected.

enhancements.name: Consecrated War Harnesses
text: Improve the Sv and Ld characteristics of UNGGOY models in this unit by 1. A Sv characteristic cannot be improved beyond 2+.

stratagems.name: Proclaim the Sacred Path
stratagems.when: Start of any phase, just after a friendly SAN'SHYUUM model issues a Fanatical Doctrine.
stratagems.target: That SAN'SHYUUM model's unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one additional friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within range of that model's Voice of the Great Journey ability. Until the end of the phase, that additional unit is affected by the same Fanatical Doctrine.

stratagems.name: Fevered Pilgrimage
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit affected by a Fanatical Doctrine is selected to move.
stratagems.target: That COVENANT INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance move.

stratagems.name: Cleanse the Sacred Ground
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit affected by a Fanatical Doctrine is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That COVENANT INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the AP characteristic of attacks made by models in your unit by 1 when they target an enemy unit within range of an objective marker.

stratagems.name: Armoured by Conviction
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit affected by a Fanatical Doctrine as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That COVENANT INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Living Bulwark
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly unattached SAN'SHYUUM CHARACTER unit as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That SAN'SHYUUM unit and one friendly non-CHARACTER COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 3" of it.
stratagems.effect: Each time one of those attacks targets your SAN'SHYUUM unit, if the selected COVENANT INFANTRY unit is an eligible target for that attack, change that attack's target to the selected COVENANT INFANTRY unit.

stratagems.name: Unquestioning Obedience
stratagems.when: Just after a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 6" of a friendly SAN'SHYUUM model fails a battle-shock roll.
stratagems.target: That COVENANT INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit suffers D3 mortal wounds, and that battle-shock roll is treated as having been passed.

enhancements_intro: The first three Enhancements can be given to SAN'SHYUUM or UNGGOY CHARACTER models, excluding Epic Heroes.

rules.name: Integrated Battle Groups
text: Line Elements are friendly COVENANT INFANTRY and MOUNTED units. Support Elements are friendly COVENANT VEHICLE and MONSTER units.

After a Line Element has made its attacks, select one enemy unit it hit: that unit is Designated until the end of the phase. After a Support Element has made its attacks, select one enemy unit it hit: that unit is Suppressed until the end of the phase.

Each time a model in a Support Element attacks a Designated unit, add 1 to the hit roll. Each time a model in a Line Element attacks a Suppressed unit, improve the AP characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Expeditionary Commander
text: Once per battle round, at the start of your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit is both Designated and Suppressed.

enhancements.name: Fleetmaster's Surveyor
text: After both players have deployed, select up to three friendly COVENANT units, excluding Fortifications. Redeploy those units. Any can instead be placed into strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Expeditionary Quartermaster
text: At the end of your Command phase, select one friendly COVENANT model within 6". It regains up to D3 lost SP. If it is a VEHICLE or MONSTER model, it also regains 1 lost wound. A model cannot be selected more than once per Command phase.

enhancements.name: Forward-Operating Cohort
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - COVENANT INFANTRY unit only, excluding CHARACTER units.
text: Models in this unit have Scouts 6".

stratagems.name: Coordinated Targeting
stratagems.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One enemy unit within 18" of and visible to at least one friendly Line Element and at least one friendly Support Element.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit is both Designated and Suppressed.

stratagems.name: Eliminate Priority Target
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a friendly COVENANT unit is selected to make attacks.
stratagems.target: That COVENANT unit and one enemy unit that is both Designated and Suppressed.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Combat Deployment
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly COVENANT TRANSPORT unit, excluding Aircraft, ends a normal move.
stratagems.target: That Transport and one friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit that started the phase embarked within it and remains embarked.
stratagems.effect: Your INFANTRY unit can immediately disembark. It cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Armoured Screen
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly Line Element as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That Line Element, provided it is within 3" of one or more friendly Support Elements.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of attacks allocated to your unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Emergency Field Repairs
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly COVENANT VEHICLE or COVENANT MONSTER unit, excluding TITANIC units, within 6" of a friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one model in the target unit. It regains D3 lost wounds and up to D3 lost SP.

stratagems.name: Tactical Withdrawal
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a friendly Line Element or Support Element is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot after making a fall-back move. If it ends that fall-back move within 6" of a friendly unit belonging to the other type of Element, it is also eligible to declare a charge this turn.

rules.name: Worthy Foe
text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army that has the CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE keyword, is within range of an objective marker, or is your opponent's Warlord's unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, that enemy unit is your Worthy Foe.
Each time a SANGHEILI model attacks your Worthy Foe, re-roll a hit roll of 1 and a wound roll of 1. SANGHEILI units can re-roll charge rolls made against your Worthy Foe.

rules.name: Exultant
text: After a SANGHEILI unit destroys your Worthy Foe, that unit immediately resolves Regenerating Shields and is Exultant until the end of your next turn.
While a unit is Exultant, it is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it made an advance or fall-back move.

enhancements.name: Master of the Hunt
text: Once per battle round, after your Worthy Foe is destroyed, if the bearer is on the battlefield, select one enemy unit visible to the bearer that is eligible to be selected as your Worthy Foe. It becomes your Worthy Foe until you select a new one.

enhancements.name: Mantle of the Blademaster
text: Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have [PRECISION]. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack against your Worthy Foe, that attack has [LETHAL HITS].

enhancements.name: Kaidon's Shield Generator
text: While the bearer is leading a SANGHEILI unit, each time that unit resolves Regenerating Shields, each SANGHEILI model in that unit regains 1 additional lost SP, up to its starting SP.

enhancements.name: Honour-Bound Veterans
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - SANGHEILI INFANTRY unit only, excluding CHARACTER units.
text: Once per battle, after this unit destroys an enemy unit that was not your Worthy Foe, it can become Exultant until the end of your next turn. This does not resolve Regenerating Shields.

stratagems.name: Relentless Pursuit
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after a SANGHEILI INFANTRY or SANGHEILI MOUNTED unit is selected to make an advance move.
stratagems.target: That SANGHEILI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge after making an advance move. If your unit is Exultant, do not make an advance roll; instead add 6" to its M characteristic until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: The Killing Stroke
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a SANGHEILI unit is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.target: That SANGHEILI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against your Worthy Foe. If your unit is Exultant, also improve the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Honour Duel
stratagems.when: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One SANGHEILI CHARACTER unit within engagement range of one or more enemy CHARACTER units.
stratagems.effect:
Select one SANGHEILI CHARACTER model in your unit and one enemy CHARACTER model within engagement range of it. Your opponent accepts or refuses the duel.
■ Accepted: until both models have fought, each can only make melee attacks against the other, and other attacks cannot be allocated to either of them. If either would be reduced to 0 wounds by the other before it has fought, it is left with 1 wound and is destroyed after it has fought. If your unit is Exultant, add 1 to the D characteristic of your model's melee weapons.
■ Refused: until the end of the phase, models in your unit can re-roll hit and wound rolls for melee attacks that target that enemy CHARACTER's unit.

stratagems.name: Shields Unbroken
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a SANGHEILI unit as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That SANGHEILI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, Shield Saves made for models in your unit succeed on a 2+. If your unit is Exultant, reduce this Stratagem's CP cost by 1CP.

stratagems.name: Death Before Dishonour
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a SANGHEILI unit as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That SANGHEILI unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed before it has fought, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove it. After the attacking unit finishes making its attacks, that model can fight and is then removed. If your unit is Exultant, this succeeds on a 3+.

stratagems.name: Claim the Trophy
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a SANGHEILI unit has fought and destroyed one or more enemy units, before it consolidates.
stratagems.target: That SANGHEILI unit.
stratagems.effect: When your unit consolidates, its models can move up to 6" instead of 3" and must end closer to the closest enemy unit or closest objective marker. If your unit is Exultant, reduce this Stratagem's CP cost by 1CP.

rules.name: Pack Encirclement
text: JIRALHANAE units can re-roll charge rolls made against an enemy unit that is within engagement range of one or more other friendly COVENANT units.

Each time a JIRALHANAE unit makes melee attacks against an enemy unit that is within engagement range of one or more other friendly COVENANT units, add 1 to the A characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that JIRALHANAE unit until it has finished making those attacks.

enhancements.name: Packmaster's Calculus
text: At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within engagement range of the bearer's unit. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit is treated as being within engagement range of another friendly COVENANT unit for the purposes of Pack Encirclement.

enhancements.name: Breachmaster's Mantle
text: Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]. When the bearer attacks an enemy unit within engagement range of another friendly COVENANT unit, add 1 to the D characteristic of those weapons.

enhancements.name: Trophy Standard
text: While the bearer is leading a unit, add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in that unit after it destroys an enemy unit in melee. This effect lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

enhancements.name: Coordinated Assault Cohort
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - JIRALHANAE INFANTRY unit only, excluding CHARACTER units.
text: Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack against an enemy unit within engagement range of another friendly COVENANT unit, re-roll a hit roll of 1 and a wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Pin the Prey
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged JIRALHANAE INFANTRY or JIRALHANAE MOUNTED unit within 12" of one or more enemy units that ended a normal, advance or fall-back move this phase.
stratagems.effect: Resolve a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that ended a normal, advance or fall-back move this phase.

stratagems.name: Crushing Envelopment
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a JIRALHANAE unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: That unit and one enemy unit within engagement range of another friendly COVENANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for melee attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Pack-Covered Advance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a JIRALHANAE unit as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That JIRALHANAE unit, provided it is within 3" of another friendly COVENANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Seize the Opening
stratagems.when: Just after another friendly COVENANT unit destroys an enemy unit in the Shooting or Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One JIRALHANAE unit within 6" of that friendly COVENANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D6". It cannot end that move within engagement range of an enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Hold Them Fast
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit within engagement range of a JIRALHANAE unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.target: That JIRALHANAE unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6. On a 3+, that enemy unit cannot make a fall-back move this phase and suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Brutal Efficiency
stratagems.when: Fight phase, just after a JIRALHANAE unit destroys an enemy unit, before it consolidates.
stratagems.target: That JIRALHANAE unit.
stratagems.effect: When your unit consolidates, its models can move up to 6" instead of 3" and must end closer to the closest enemy unit or closest objective marker.

rules.name: Scuttle to Cover
text: Once per battle round, each time a friendly YIG-YAR unit is selected as the target of one or more ranged attacks, before those attacks are made, it can make a normal move of up to D6+2". The attacking unit can then select new targets for any of its attacks. Each YIG-YAR unit can do this once per battle round.

enhancements.name: Corsair's Route-Map
text: After both players have deployed, select up to three friendly YIG-YAR units. Redeploy those units. Any can instead be placed into strategic reserves.

enhancements.name: Refraction Shield Matrix
text: While the bearer is leading a YIG-YAR unit, after that unit makes a Scuttle to Cover move, Shield Saves made for models in that unit succeed on a 2+ until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Predator Optics
text: Ranged weapons equipped by the bearer have [IGNORES COVER]. Each time the bearer makes a ranged attack against a unit that is below starting strength, an unmodified hit roll of 5+ is a critical hit.

enhancements.name: Forward Talon
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - YIG-YAR INFANTRY unit only, excluding CHARACTER units.
text: Models in this unit have Scouts 6". This unit remains eligible to start an action after making a Scuttle to Cover move.

stratagems.name: Break the Firing Solution
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when a YIG-YAR unit makes a Scuttle to Cover move.
stratagems.target: That YIG-YAR unit.
stratagems.effect: Do not roll to determine the distance of that move. Your unit can move up to 8" instead and can move through friendly models, but cannot end on top of them.

stratagems.name: Return Fire
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.target: One YIG-YAR unit that was targeted by one or more of those attacks and is eligible to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit shoots using Snap Shooting, but can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Crossfire Quarry
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a YIG-YAR unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That unit and one enemy unit visible to another friendly YIG-YAR unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the AP characteristic of ranged attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Hidden Firing Lanes
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a YIG-YAR INFANTRY unit wholly within a terrain feature is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Snare the Advance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit declares a charge against a YIG-YAR INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.target: That YIG-YAR unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from charge rolls made for that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Vanish Into the Rocks
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One YIG-YAR INFANTRY unit that is unengaged.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into strategic reserves.

rules.name: Invasion Vessels
text: For this Detachment, friendly Spirit, Phantom, Lich and Kraken units are Invasion Vessels.

rules.name: Planetfall Operations
text: After a friendly COVENANT unit disembarks from an Invasion Vessel during your Movement phase, it can make a normal move of up to 3". Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is a Landing Force.
Add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in Landing Force units.

rules.name: Fleet Command Network
text: A Sangheili Shipmaster embarked within an Invasion Vessel can use Shipmaster's Command and Glassing Beam. When it does, measure distances and determine visibility from any friendly Invasion Vessel on the battlefield.

enhancements.name: Precision Gravity-Lift Array
text: When a unit disembarks from this unit and makes the normal move granted by Planetfall Operations, it can move up to 6" instead of 3".

enhancements.name: Reinforced Energy Projectors
text: Once per battle, just after this model is reduced to 0 SP, it immediately resolves Regenerating Shields.

enhancements.name: Groundside Targeting Beacon
text: At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 18" of and visible to the bearer. Until the end of the phase, ranged attacks made by friendly Landing Force and Invasion Vessel units against that enemy unit have [IGNORES COVER].

enhancements.name: Orbital Homing Beacon
text: Once per battle, when a friendly Invasion Vessel is set up from reserves, one model in that unit can be set up within 9" of the bearer and more than 6" horizontally from every enemy model.

enhancements.name: Veteran of the First Wave
text: While the bearer is leading a Landing Force unit, add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in that unit and battle-shock rolls made for that unit can be re-rolled.

enhancements.name: Flagship Command Throne
text: Once per battle round, when the bearer uses Shipmaster's Command, it can issue the selected Doctrine to one additional eligible COVENANT unit within range. Select a different unit for the second use.

enhancements.name: Master of Descent Vectors
text: After both players have deployed, select up to two friendly Invasion Vessel units. Redeploy those units or place them into strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Launch the Second Wave
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an empty Phantom disembarks from a Lich or Kraken.
stratagems.target: That Lich or Kraken, that Phantom, and any number of COVENANT INFANTRY units embarked within the Lich or Kraken.
stratagems.effect: Select any number of the targeted INFANTRY units, one at a time. Transfer each selected unit into the Phantom until its Transport capacity is filled. Any unit that cannot fit remains embarked within the original Invasion Vessel.

stratagems.name: Renewed Glassing Authorisation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a Sangheili Shipmaster model that has already used Glassing Beam is selected to use that ability.
stratagems.target: That Sangheili Shipmaster model.
stratagems.effect: The bearer can use Glassing Beam one additional time this battle.
stratagems.restriction: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Orbital Descent Vector
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, just after an Invasion Vessel is set up from reserves.
stratagems.target: That Invasion Vessel.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 8", but cannot end that move within 6" of any enemy model.

stratagems.name: Return to the Fleet
stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: One Landing Force INFANTRY unit within 6" of a friendly Invasion Vessel and unengaged.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can immediately embark within that Invasion Vessel, even if that Invasion Vessel made a normal move this turn.

stratagems.name: Hold the Beachhead
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a Landing Force unit as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That Landing Force unit, provided it is within 6" of a friendly Invasion Vessel.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Clear the Landing Zone
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a Landing Force or Invasion Vessel unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.target: That unit and one enemy unit within range of an objective marker.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

rules.name: Shadow Cell Units
text: For this Detachment, Shadow Cell units are units with the Special Operations, Ranger, Assassin or Blademaster keyword, and Rtas 'Vadum's unit. Sergeant and Auxiliary keywords do not make their parent unit eligible.

rules.name: Active Camouflage Network
text: At the end of your turn, select one friendly Shadow Cell unit that is unengaged. Until the start of your next turn, or just after that unit shoots or fights, whichever comes first, it is Concealed. While a unit is Concealed, it can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

enhancements.name: Covert Field Commander
text: The bearer can be attached to a Special Operations Team or Sangheili Assassin unit. Once per battle round, at the start of any phase, it can issue one Sangheili Special Operations Doctrine to its own unit. All normal Caste Doctrine restrictions apply.

enhancements.name: Experimental Active Camouflage
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - Shadow Cell INFANTRY unit only, excluding CHARACTER units.
text: Once per battle round, just after this unit has shot, if it is unengaged, it can become Concealed. If it does, it cannot declare a charge that turn.

enhancements.name: Black Team Insertion
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - Shadow Cell INFANTRY unit only, excluding CHARACTER units.
text: This unit has the Deep Strike ability.

stratagems.name: Perfect Ambush
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a Concealed Shadow Cell unit is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.target: That Shadow Cell unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS]. Ranged weapons equipped by those models also have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Vanish Without Trace
stratagems.when: Just after a Shadow Cell unit has shot or fought.
stratagems.target: That unit, provided it is unengaged.
stratagems.effect: Your unit becomes Concealed. If used after your unit shot, it cannot declare a charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Remote Sabotage
stratagems.when: End of your opponent's Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One Shadow Cell unit within 6" of an enemy VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one such enemy unit. It suffers D3 mortal wounds and must make a battle-shock roll.

rules.name: Armored Spearhead Units
text: For this Detachment, an Armored Spearhead unit is a friendly COVENANT VEHICLE or MOUNTED unit, excluding AIRCRAFT and TITANIC units.

rules.name: Shielded Formation
text: Each time a model in an Armored Spearhead unit resolves Regenerating Shields, if its unit is within 6" of another friendly Armored Spearhead unit, that model regains 1 additional lost SP. While an Armored Spearhead model has one or more SP, add 1 to its OC characteristic.

enhancements.name: Overcharged Deflection Array
enhancements.restriction: Upgrade - Armored Spearhead unit with an SP characteristic only.
text: Add 2 to the SP characteristic of models in this unit.

enhancements.name: Command-pattern Sensor Suite
text: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1 if the target is visible to another friendly Armored Spearhead unit.

stratagems.name: Power to Forward Shields
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects an Armored Spearhead unit as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That unit, provided it is within 6" of another friendly Armored Spearhead unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, Shield Saves made for models in your unit succeed on a 2+.

stratagems.name: Concentrated Plasma Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when an Armored Spearhead unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That unit and one enemy unit hit by a different friendly Armored Spearhead unit this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the AP characteristic of attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit by 1.

stratagems.name: Gravitic Breakthrough
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when an Armored Spearhead unit is selected to make a normal or advance move.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of that move, models in your unit can move horizontally through other models, excluding TITANIC models, and through terrain features 4" or less in height. They cannot end that move on another model or within engagement range of an enemy unit.

rules.name: Replacement Drafts
text: At the end of your Command phase, select one friendly GRUNT unit that is below starting strength. Return up to D3+2 destroyed Unggoy Warrior models to that unit. Sergeant, Auxiliary and CHARACTER models cannot be returned using this rule.

enhancements.name: Master of the Muster
enhancements.restriction: COVENANT CHARACTER model only, excluding Epic Heroes.
text: While the bearer is leading a GRUNT unit, each time that unit is selected for Replacement Drafts, return 2 additional Unggoy Warrior models.

enhancements.name: Surplus Plasma Cells
text: Once per battle, when this unit is selected to shoot, it can activate this Upgrade. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 1 to the A characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by Unggoy Warrior models in this unit.

enhancements.name: Volatile Charge Packs
text: Add 1 to this unit's Proximity Detonation rolls. Each time you roll to determine mortal wounds inflicted by that ability, you can re-roll that roll.

stratagems.name: Massed Plasma Volley
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when an UNGGOY INFANTRY unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by UNGGOY models in your unit have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Expendable Screen
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly non-GRUNT COVENANT INFANTRY unit as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That COVENANT INFANTRY unit and one friendly GRUNT unit within 3" of it.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time one of those attacks targets your COVENANT INFANTRY unit, if the selected GRUNT unit is an eligible target, change that attack's target to that GRUNT unit.

stratagems.name: More Where They Came From
stratagems.when: Your Command phase, just after resolving Replacement Drafts.
stratagems.target: One different GRUNT unit that is below starting strength.
stratagems.effect: Return up to D3+1 destroyed Unggoy Warrior models to that unit.

rules.name: Distributed Swarm-mind
text: When determining whether a DRONE SWARM unit contains six or more models for its Swarming Flight ability, if that unit is within 6" of another friendly Drone Swarm, count the models in both units. Once per battle round, just after a Yanme'e Major issues a Yanme'e Caste Doctrine to its unit, select one other friendly Drone Swarm within 6" that is not affected by a Caste Doctrine. Until the end of the phase, that unit is affected by the same Doctrine.

enhancements.name: Dominant Control Node
text: When this model uses Distributed Swarm-mind, it can affect up to two other DRONE SWARM units within 9" instead of one within 6".

enhancements.name: Armoured Drone Morphs
text: Yanme'e Drone models in this unit have a Sv characteristic of 5+.

enhancements.name: Razorwing Brood
text: Add 1 to the A characteristic and improve the AP characteristic by 1 for Drone Claws equipped by models in this unit.

stratagems.name: Replenish the Brood
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: One DRONE SWARM unit that is below starting strength.
stratagems.effect: Return up to D3+2 destroyed Yanme'e Drone models to that unit. A Yanme'e Major cannot be returned.
stratagems.restriction: The same unit can only be targeted once per battle.

stratagems.name: Obscuring Swarm
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly COVENANT unit within 3" of a Drone Swarm as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That COVENANT unit and that Drone Swarm.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, subtract 1 from hit rolls made against the selected COVENANT unit. After those attacks are resolved, the Drone Swarm suffers D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Attack From Every Angle
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a Drone Swarm is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.target: That unit and one enemy unit within 6" of a different friendly Drone Swarm.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

rules.name: Colony Bonds
text: During Declare Battle Formations, you can organise friendly MGALEKGOLO units into bonds of two. Each unit can have only one Bondmate. Each time a MGALEKGOLO unit attacks an enemy unit that was hit by its Bondmate earlier in the same phase, re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1. When a MGALEKGOLO unit's Bondmate is destroyed, add 1 to the A characteristic of weapons equipped by models in the surviving unit for the remainder of the battle.

enhancements.name: Regenerative Worm-mass
text: At the start of your Command phase, one model in this unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Ancient Colony
text: Add 1 to the OC characteristic of models in this unit, and battle-shock rolls made for this unit can be re-rolled.

stratagems.name: Interlocking Shields
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a MGALEKGOLO unit as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That unit, provided it is within 6" of its Bondmate.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the AP characteristic of those attacks by 1.

stratagems.name: Synchronized Destruction
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a MGALEKGOLO unit is selected to shoot or fight.
stratagems.target: That unit and one enemy unit hit by its Bondmate this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Wrath of the Bereaved
stratagems.when: Just after an enemy unit destroys a MGALEKGOLO unit's Bondmate.
stratagems.target: The surviving MGALEKGOLO unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of your next turn, add 1 to Hit and wound rolls for attacks made by your unit against the enemy unit that destroyed its Bondmate.

rules.name: Reclamation Sites
text: Whenever a VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION unit is destroyed, before removing its last model, place a Reclamation marker as close as possible to the centre of that model. At the end of your Movement phase, one friendly HURAGOK model within 3" of a Reclamation marker can reclaim it. Remove that marker and select one: one friendly COVENANT VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION model within 6" regains up to D3+2 lost wounds or D3+2 lost SP; or you gain 1CP. Only one Reclamation marker can be reclaimed per battle round. Reclamation markers are not objective markers or terrain features.

enhancements.name: Master Reclaimer
enhancements.restriction: HURAGOK CHARACTER model only, excluding Epic Heroes.
text: The bearer's Repair and Refit ability has a range of 6" instead of 3", and the selected model regains D3+2 lost wounds or SP instead of D3+1.

enhancements.name: Expanded Defence Field
enhancements.restriction: HURAGOK CHARACTER model only, excluding Epic Heroes.
text: Friendly non-TITANIC COVENANT VEHICLE and FORTIFICATION models within 6" of the bearer have Feel No Pain 6+.

enhancements.name: Biological Reconstitution Archive
enhancements.restriction: HURAGOK CHARACTER model only, excluding Epic Heroes.
text: When the bearer reclaims a Reclamation marker, instead of selecting either normal effect, select one friendly COVENANT INFANTRY unit within 6". Return one destroyed non-CHARACTER, non-Sergeant and non-Auxiliary model with a starting W characteristic of 3 or less to that unit with its full wounds remaining. MGALEKGOLO models cannot be returned.

stratagems.name: Field-fabricated Emplacement
stratagems.when: End of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One HURAGOK unit within 3" of a Reclamation marker.
stratagems.effect: Remove that marker. Set up one new Covenant Deployable Turret unit at starting strength wholly within 3" of your Huragok and more than 3" from all enemy models.
stratagems.restriction: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Last-second Stabilisation
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit finishes making attacks that destroyed a friendly non-TITANIC COVENANT VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION unit within 3" of a friendly HURAGOK model.
stratagems.target: That destroyed unit and one such HURAGOK unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6. On a 3+, return one destroyed model from the target unit to the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and outside engagement range of enemy models. It has 1 wound remaining and 0 SP.
stratagems.restriction: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

stratagems.name: Emergency Shield Reboot
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit selects a friendly COVENANT VEHICLE or FORTIFICATION unit as the target of one or more attacks.
stratagems.target: That unit, provided one of its models has a starting SP characteristic greater than 0, currently has 0 SP, and is within 6" of a friendly HURAGOK model.
stratagems.effect: Before those attacks are resolved, one model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost SP.
